sample: Existing data/clean, explicitly conditional on complete subsequent payoffs; formation-only audit retained
chronology: January-close decisions; January-December formation dates realize February-next January
bandwidth: Initial-sample median distance, fixed for all main figures
penalty_grid: Existing 120 initial-training complexity-spaced penalties per representation; minimum-norm zero diagnostic excluded from selection
selection: Minimum prior-validation mean (1-raw monthly aggregate payoff)^2, followed by pretest-history refit
scale: Common linear-policy initial-validation median gross calibration, 0.03740000227285338; fixed before February 1978

bootstrap.scope: Paired conditional policy-path diagnostics; pointwise intervals, no full-pipeline inference

neural.intercept: Explicit constant feature, penalized along with all 64 raw hidden features
neural.training: Adam hidden updates from uniform complete-month batches, exact full-history ridge head refreshed every 16 steps. Restart from seed for each inner stage/refit. Extractor penalty fixed at initial stage trace/65 times 0.01. Validate both stopping budgets and exact-head ratios; refit selected budget and ratio on pretest history with no reselection. Raw hidden features are not whitened or normalized.
neural.dtype: float32 extractor and monthly aggregation; float64 exact ridge head and accounting

freeze_interpretation: Revision execution protocol, not a retrospective preregistration
